description: This header file defines interfaces, constants, and data structures for managing a reverse index within a Git pack file system, enabling efficient mapping between object indices, pack positions, and offsets. It declares functions for loading, verifying, and converting between these representations, particularly in the context of multi-pack indexes.

methods.name: load_pack_revindex
methods.description: Populates the reverse index for a given pack, returning 0 on success or a negative value on error.

methods.name: load_pack_revindex_from_disk
methods.description: Loads a pack's reverse index directly from disk, returning 0 on success, 1 if no revision file, or -1 on parse error.

methods.name: verify_pack_revindex
methods.description: Verifies that the on-disk reverse index matches what would be generated from scratch, returning a negative value on error.

methods.name: load_midx_revindex
methods.description: Loads the multi-pack index reverse index via memory mapping, returning a negative value on error.

methods.name: close_midx_revindex
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a multi-pack reverse index.

methods.name: offset_to_pack_pos
methods.description: Converts a byte offset within a pack to a pack position index; loads the reverse index lazily if needed.

methods.name: pack_pos_to_index
methods.description: Converts a pack-relative position to an index-relative position; aborts on invalid input.

methods.name: pack_pos_to_offset
methods.description: Converts a pack-relative position to a byte offset within the pack.

methods.name: pack_pos_to_midx
methods.description: Converts a pack-relative position within a multi-pack index to a MIDX position.

methods.name: midx_to_pack_pos
methods.description: Converts a MIDX position back to a pack position, running in logarithmic time.

methods.name: midx_pair_to_pack_pos
methods.description: Converts a specific pair of pack id and offset within a multi-pack index to a pack position.
